title: Quietly Smoky Ethiopian Pork Knuckle Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Ethiopian-inspired stew featuring pork knuckle, binchotan-charcoal smoked for added depth, perfect for a post-workout meal, and can be adapted to be vegan-friendly by substituting the pork with a plant-based alternative.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pork knuckle and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine, smoked with binchotan charcoal, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt and ethiopian red pepper to taste.
